name: Sabores "The Havana" Roasted Pork, Smoked Turkey & Swiss on French Bread
whyItWorks: Slow-roasted pork, smoked turkey breast, ham, and naturally lactose-safe Swiss cheese pressed on soft white French bread offer a high-protein sandwich when ordered without spicy sauce or pickles.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order "The Havana" sandwich on French bread with Swiss cheese only—ask for no pickles, no raw onions, and sauce on the side.
watchOuts: Skip the side pasta salad if dressed with raw onions/peppers; swap for white rice or plain kettle chips
